caption:
The video captures a bright blue sky where crepuscular sunbeams fan upward from behind a central cumulus cloud mass near the lower edge. Darker cloud wisps sit along the lower-left and lower-right margins. The beams keep a steady number and broad spread, and their brightness looks broadly constant. The cloud and ray arrangement appears to shift slowly upward across the view, with the cloud top rising gradually into the open sky.

A small dark bird silhouette drifts into view near the top center and moves on a diagonal path toward the right side of the sky. Its shape briefly shows outstretched wings as it travels across the open blue. It remains a tiny dark mark, descending gradually from the upper region toward the mid-right, then drifting slightly lower and left while staying visible.

A few faint additional specks appear intermittently in the mid-sky, while the steady beams and the slow upward drift of the cloud remain the dominant backdrop in the open sky.
relations: Cumulus occludes the sun, so rays fan upward; cloud and rays drift slowly upward together across the frame.
A small dark bird enters near top center, moves diagonally right, and descends gradually while staying a tiny silhouette.
Faint specks appear intermittently in the mid-sky while ray number and broad spread remain roughly constant.
